definitions.explanation: A bright red deep-sea fish with large golden eyes and soft white flesh, prized in Japan and usually served simmered in soy sauce ({煮付|につ}け) or as sashimi. Despite the name it is not a true {鯛|たい} (sea bream).

examples.japanese: {金目鯛|きんめだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧。
⟦{伊豆|いず}→伊豆：31155_izu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金目鯛|きんめだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The Izu Peninsula is famous for its alfonsino.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{金目鯛|きんめだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丸|まる}ごと→丸ごと：10545_marugoto⟧⟦{一匹|いっぴき}→一匹：08930_ippiki⟧⟦{出|で}てきて→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised when a whole alfonsino came out at dinner at the inn.

notes:
{金目|きんめ} (golden eyes) + ⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧ (sea bream). Often shortened to {金目|きんめ}. A rather expensive fish, especially associated with Izu and Chōshi.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金目鯛|きんめだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧: alfonsino simmered in sweet soy sauce, the classic dish
- {金目鯛|きんめだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦しゃぶしゃぶ→しゃぶしゃぶ：10479_shabushabu⟧: alfonsino hot pot

SIMILAR WORDS:
